IRON_TIP.name: Iron Tip
IRON_TIP.effect: MELEE ONLY: bypass 15% of enemy resistance.

TRAINING_SCROLL.name: Training Scroll
TRAINING_SCROLL.effect: Basic drill: +5% damage and +8% attack speed.

QUICKDRAW_GLOVES.name: Quickdraw Gloves
QUICKDRAW_GLOVES.effect: RANGED ONLY: +22% attack speed and +0.5 tile range.

BARBED_GLADIUS.name: Barbed Gladius
BARBED_GLADIUS.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies Bleed (1.2% HP/sec, 8.8s) on hit.

TRUESIGHT_LENS.name: Truesight Lens
TRUESIGHT_LENS.effect: REVEAL ON SIGHT: any stealth/ambush enemy that enters the carrier's range is permanently revealed for the rest of the wave — every tower on the map can target it from that moment on. Enemies cross the range threshold one by one and reveal in order.

FIRE_OIL_FLASK.name: Fire Oil Flask
FIRE_OIL_FLASK.effect: RANGED ONLY: applies Burn (4% HP/sec, 3.3s) with 1-tile splash on impact.

POISONED_BLADE.name: Poisoned Blade
POISONED_BLADE.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies Poison (4% HP/sec, 4.4s) on hit.

CAVALRY_SPUR.name: Cavalry Spur
CAVALRY_SPUR.effect: MELEE ONLY: +25% attack speed, +0.5 tile range.

CENTURIONS_TRUMPET.name: Centurion's Trumpet
CENTURIONS_TRUMPET.effect: Aura 2.5 tiles: allies gain +18% attack speed

SCIPIO_PLAYBOOK.name: Scipio's Playbook
SCIPIO_PLAYBOOK.effect: +35% damage to whichever enemy in range has the highest HP.

AQUILIFER_BANNER.name: Aquilifer's Banner
AQUILIFER_BANNER.effect: AURA 3 tiles: nearby towers +20% damage and +15% attack speed.

ALPHA_PACK_FANG.name: Alpha Pack Fang
ALPHA_PACK_FANG.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies ruinous Bleed (5% HP/sec, 16.5s) on hit.

WAR_HOUND_COLLAR.name: War Hound Collar
WAR_HOUND_COLLAR.effect: Aura 3 tiles: allies gain +22% damage and +18% attack speed

GALLIC_SHIELD_BOSS.name: Gallic Shield Boss
GALLIC_SHIELD_BOSS.effect: Any tower: every 4th hit shield-bashes the target, stunning non-boss enemies for 1s.

FALCATA_BLADE.name: Falcata Blade
FALCATA_BLADE.effect: MELEE ONLY: applies savage Bleed (6% HP/sec, 11s) on hit.

BARCA_WAR_HORN.name: Barca War Horn
BARCA_WAR_HORN.effect: Aura 3.5 tiles: allies gain +30% damage, +20% attack speed

CURSED_TORC.name: Cursed Torc
CURSED_TORC.effect: Aura 3 tiles: enemies in range take +35% damage from all sources

LICH_GENERALS_SEAL.name: Lich General's Seal
LICH_GENERALS_SEAL.effect: Aura 3.5 tiles: allies gain +30% damage, +30% attack speed

AQUILA_TALONS.name: Aquila Talons
AQUILA_TALONS.effect: MELEE ONLY: tower can target flyers and deals +90% damage to them.

SPEAR_OF_MARS.name: Spear of Mars
SPEAR_OF_MARS.effect: MELEE ONLY: +60% damage and +7 tile range.

JUPITERS_WRATH.name: Jupiter's Wrath
JUPITERS_WRATH.effect: Every attack arcs lightning to 3 nearby enemies (60% damage decay per jump) and stuns the primary 0.4s.

CAPITOLINE_AEGIS.name: Capitoline Aegis
CAPITOLINE_AEGIS.effect: Any tower: adds +35% of its attack as a separate DIVINE damage rider on hit. This is additional damage, does not replace the tower's native damage type, and helps answer divine-only enemies.

FALX_BLADE.name: Falx Blade
FALX_BLADE.effect: MELEE ONLY: grants CLEAVE. Each swing hits every enemy in melee range; secondary targets take 60% damage. On native cleave towers, upgrades secondary damage from 70% to 90%.

VOLLEY_QUIVER.name: Volley Quiver
VOLLEY_QUIVER.effect: RANGED ONLY: +1 target per attack. Stacks additively on multi-shot towers.

SIGIL_OF_SOL_INVICTUS.name: Sigil of Sol Invictus
SIGIL_OF_SOL_INVICTUS.effect: Any tower: +150% damage vs Demons. Old augurs whisper that a Tier IV or V War Chariot bearing this sigil becomes the sun's own war machine. The sigil remains bound after awakening.

TYRANTS_LAUREL.name: Tyrant's Laurel
TYRANTS_LAUREL.effect: Any tower: +150% damage vs Bosses. Stacks multiplicatively with native boss bonuses. One per run.

VESTAL_PYRE.name: Vestal Pyre
VESTAL_PYRE.effect: Any tower: applies BURN (5% maxHP/sec for 3.3s) on hit. Counts as a FIRE-damage source.

VENOM_TIPPED_ARROWS.name: Venom-Tipped Arrows
VENOM_TIPPED_ARROWS.effect: RANGED ONLY: applies POISON (5% maxHP/sec for 4.4s) on hit.

SERPENT_AMULET.name: Serpent Amulet
SERPENT_AMULET.effect: Any tower: applies POISON (3% maxHP/sec for 5.5s) on hit.

WITCHS_VENOM.name: Witch's Venom
WITCHS_VENOM.effect: Any tower: applies POISON (4% maxHP/sec for 5.5s) on hit.

OPTIO_WHISTLE.name: Optio's Whistle
OPTIO_WHISTLE.effect: Aura 3 tiles: nearby allies gain +28% attack speed.

BRONZE_GREAVES.name: Bronze Greaves
BRONZE_GREAVES.effect: MELEE ONLY: +0.5 tile reach and +10% damage.

RUSTED_HASTA.name: Rusted Hasta
RUSTED_HASTA.effect: Any tower: +14% damage vs GROUND enemies (flyers excluded).

AUGUR_SCROLL.name: Augur's Scroll
AUGUR_SCROLL.effect: Any tower: +18% attack speed, +0.5 tile range.

AQUILA_RAMPART.name: Aquila Rampart
AQUILA_RAMPART.effect: Any tower: +100% damage vs enemies above 70% HP.

PERIMETER_TORCH.name: Perimeter Torch
PERIMETER_TORCH.effect: Any tower: +50% damage and +50% attack speed.

GRAVEKEEPERS_SCYTHE.name: Gravekeeper's Scythe
GRAVEKEEPERS_SCYTHE.effect: Any tower: +125% damage vs Undead-faction enemies.

SOULFIRE_BRAND.name: Soulfire Brand
SOULFIRE_BRAND.effect: Any tower: applies HELLFIRE on hit (7% maxHP/sec for 4.4s). True damage — ignores all resists and immunities.

NECROMANCERS_LANTERN.name: Necromancer's Lantern
NECROMANCERS_LANTERN.effect: Aura 3.5 tiles: enemies take +45% direct damage and cannot regenerate or receive checkpoint healing while inside.

HELLGATE_BRAND.name: Hellgate Brand
HELLGATE_BRAND.effect: Any tower: +80% damage, +40% attack speed. Immune to silence and tower-slow auras.

DEMONSWORN_CROWN.name: Demonsworn Crown
DEMONSWORN_CROWN.effect: Any tower: +150% damage vs Demon-faction enemies and +100% damage vs Bosses.

INFERNO_STANDARD.name: Inferno Standard
INFERNO_STANDARD.effect: Aura 3.5 tiles: nearby allies gain +40% damage and every attack applies BURN (8% maxHP/sec for 3.3s) on hit.

DAMNATIO_MEMORIAE.name: Damnatio Memoriae
DAMNATIO_MEMORIAE.effect: MELEE ONLY: executes non-Boss enemies below 35% HP. Give it to a Tier IV or V Praetorian Executioner, and Rome may remember an office erased from history. The name remains bound after awakening.

SKYPIERCER_BOLTS.name: Skypiercer Bolts
SKYPIERCER_BOLTS.effect: +85% damage vs Flyers. Equips on any tower.

FALCONERS_WATCHPOST.name: Falconer's Watchpost
FALCONERS_WATCHPOST.effect: +3 tile range and +40% attack speed. Reach out and shred fliers before they pass.

JUPITERS_SKYFIRE.name: Jupiter's Skyfire
JUPITERS_SKYFIRE.effect: +140% damage vs Flyers. The sky-god scorches their wings from the air.

STORM_AQUILA_TALONS.name: Storm Aquila Talons
STORM_AQUILA_TALONS.effect: Any tower: targets Flyers, +90% damage vs Flyers, and +2 range. In the hands of a Tier IV or V Beastlord Champion, the oldest aquilae are said to hunt for themselves. The talons remain bound after awakening.

EXECUTIONERS_FALX.name: Executioner's Falx
EXECUTIONERS_FALX.effect: MELEE ONLY: grants full-power CLEAVE. Every swing hits up to 9 enemies in melee range and secondary targets take FULL (100%) damage.

CONCUSSIVE_WARHEAD.name: Concussive Warhead
CONCUSSIVE_WARHEAD.effect: RANGED ONLY: every shot detonates in a 1.6-tile blast, dealing SPLASH damage to all enemies caught in it.

BRINEHOOK_ROPE.name: Brinehook Rope
BRINEHOOK_ROPE.effect: Any tower: +30% damage vs ocean-spawn enemies and commanders.

TIDEPIERCER_HARPOON.name: Tidepiercer Harpoon
TIDEPIERCER_HARPOON.effect: RANGED ONLY: +70% damage vs ocean-spawn enemies, sea giants, and Tidecallers.

AEGEAN_PEARL.name: Aegean Pearl
AEGEAN_PEARL.effect: Harbor towers: +35% damage and +0.75 range. Non-Harbor towers: +45% damage vs ocean-spawn enemies.

STORMGLASS_AMPHORA.name: Stormglass Amphora
STORMGLASS_AMPHORA.effect: Any tower: +55% damage vs ocean-spawn enemies. Harbor and Tideforged towers also gain +20% attack speed.

NEPTUNES_TRIDENT.name: Neptune's Trident
NEPTUNES_TRIDENT.effect: Harbor towers: +60% damage, +20% attack speed, +1 range. Other towers: +55% damage vs ocean-spawn enemies.

GIANTS_BANE.name: Giant's Bane
GIANTS_BANE.effect: Forged for hands larger than men. Give it to a Tier V Milites or Cohort Guard, and an ancient giant-hunter may wake within the ranks. The awakened tower holds four items; Giant's Bane remains bound.

WITCHS_BREW.name: Witch's Brew
WITCHS_BREW.effect: Arena sand and bone ash churn inside. Give it to a Tier IV or V Murmillo, and the dead may crown a new gladiator king. The awakened tower holds four items; Witch's Brew remains bound.

CENSER_OF_MEFITIS.name: Censer of Mefitis
CENSER_OF_MEFITIS.effect: Its fumes remember every plague Rome buried. Give it to a Tier IV or V Plague Lobber, and a fouler engine may wake. The awakened tower holds four items; the censer remains bound.

EAGLE_OF_APOTHEOSIS.name: Eagle of Apotheosis
EAGLE_OF_APOTHEOSIS.effect: ONE USE: Rome's eagle lifts a kept non-hero tower to Tier V during preparation, then vanishes without taking an item slot. It cannot break Scorpio or Velites beyond Tier IV. One is promised after the first Flyer wave; later Eagles are rare.
